niche.habitat: Mid to upper decks, near thermal updrafts and jet streams
niche.active: Continuous, ambush predators following thermal layers

body: Sleek, needle-like predators with swept-back wings and ventral thermal bladders. They ride adiabatic updrafts, using metabolic heat to expand gas for rapid ascent, then dive with red-shifted eyes locked on thermal signatures.

chains.trait: Compressed gas ram-jets for burst acceleration
links: Low H₂ density starves conventional hydrofoils
Metabolic CO₂ is rapidly compressed and vented
Delivers short-duration kinetic strikes
100 m/s zonal winds demand constant forward momentum

skill.effect: The creature winds up briefly before launching a powerful ram that strikes nearby targets with great force.

chains.weakness: Leaves a brief jet-wake vortex that alerts prey and breaks stealth
observe: Torn cloud vapor and shock rings

journal.en: They don't fly; they kick the atmosphere into submission.

plausibility.summary: Frame vents as stored metabolic gas (H₂/CH₄ mix) expelled through constricted nozzles for squid-like thrust, not a true ram-compressor; Ram Strike damage comes from kinetic impact after jet burst, not a 50 m gas shock in thin 1-bar H₂.
fixes: Frame vents as stored metabolic gas (H₂/CH₄ mix) expelled through constricted nozzles for squid-like thrust, not a true ram-compressor; Ram Strike damage comes from kinetic impact after jet burst, not a 50 m gas shock in thin 1-bar H₂.

analogues.organism: Squid and cuttlefish mantle jet propulsion (high-pressure siphon expulsion); burst pursuit in low-density medium resembles flying squid (Todarodes) leaving water.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded
see the cited works; chain wording is the council's own

chains.trait: Thermal bladder equalizes depth via adiabatic venting
links: Vertical migration against 2.6 g gravity requires constant buoyancy trim
Adiabatic compression during descent squeezes gas pockets, raising internal pressure
Metabolic H₂ slowly restores volume, while thermal expansion offsets density changes during ascent
Equalization lag creates a tactical window for ballistic dives

skill.effect: The creature plummets from high above, creating a powerful shockwave that stuns nearby targets. Afterward, it must slowly rise back up to recharge its pressure system before diving again.

chains.weakness: Rapid venting in thin upper air causes decompression bubbles, slowing movement by 40% for 5 s.

journal.en: Inflate, dive, crush. The cycle is simple.

analogues.organism: Elephant infrasonic communication and seismic/vibrotactile foot detection; lateral line–like pressure sensing in fish (mechanotransduction in neuromasts).
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Aerosol haze reduces visual range to tens of meters
H₂ atmosphere transmits low-frequency sound over kilometers
Membrane flaps detect pressure variations below 100 Hz
Tracks floating prey by their buoyancy modulation

skill.effect: The creature listens closely to the water, revealing hidden enemies nearby and striking its targets with greater precision.

chains.weakness: Blind to high-frequency alarm whistles used by some prey
observe: Cloud vapor distortion around sensory arrays

journal.en: They hear the heartbeat of the sky.

links: Stellar flux at 5.2 AU is only 3.5% of Earth's
Visible spectrum photons are too sparse for rapid hunting
G2V star peaks in longer wavelengths after atmospheric scattering
Porphyrin-based pigments absorb 600–900 nm

skill.effect: The creature pierces through thick haze to spot heat signatures, ensuring its initial strikes land with remarkable accuracy.

chains.weakness: Flash-blind when struck by direct lightning discharge in water clouds

journal.en: They see what we call invisible.

plausibility.summary: Split Thermal Track: NIR vision (bacteriochlorophyll-analog opsins, 700–900 nm) for navigation and silhouette in haze; separate pit-organ or trigeminal IR for metabolic heat at close range. Lightning flash-blind affects whichever channel is primary.
fixes: Split Thermal Track: NIR vision (bacteriochlorophyll-analog opsins, 700–900 nm) for navigation and silhouette in haze; separate pit-organ or trigeminal IR for metabolic heat at close range. Lightning flash-blind affects whichever channel is primary.

analogues.organism: Anoxygenic phototrophs with bacteriochlorophyll (e.g. purple nonsulfur bacteria); pit viper (Crotalus) IR-sensitive trigeminal pits for strike targeting.

chains.trait: Swept-back hydrofoils generate lift via high Reynolds flow
links: Low H₂ density starves static lift, demanding high Reynolds number flow
Swept-back membranes deflect gas to ride jet shear layers and dynamic soar
Foils supplement ram-jets, maintaining minimum dynamic pressure during turns in 2.6 g
Localized turbulence pockets in shear edges cause unpredictable stall conditions

skill.effect: The creature surfs a fast current to glide forward swiftly while deflecting incoming attacks. It must keep its jets active to maintain its momentum.

chains.weakness: Stalls completely in localized turbulence dead zones, leaving it drifting and defenseless for 3 s.
observe: Ammonium hydrosulfide ice fouling on foil tips

journal.en: A living sail riding a hurricane.

plausibility.summary: Hydrofoils supplement jets and neutral buoyancy (F16), not solo flight at 110 m/s: use shear-layer surfing for repositioning and damage reduction at sub-jet speeds while jets maintain minimum dynamic pressure in 2.6 g thin H₂. Remove salt-crusted tips or replace with ammonium hydrosulfide ice fouling.
fixes: Hydrofoils supplement jets and neutral buoyancy (F16), not solo flight at 110 m/s: use shear-layer surfing for repositioning and damage reduction at sub-jet speeds while jets maintain minimum dynamic pressure in 2.6 g thin H₂. Remove salt-crusted tips or replace with ammonium hydrosulfide ice fouling.

analogues.organism: Albatross dynamic soaring on wind shear; flying fish gliding plus powered escape; Sagan-Salpeter hunters with active locomotion in banded winds.

moments: A sudden crack of displaced air as it drops from the stratosphere, wings folding into a razor-edged dive that leaves ionized trails.
